note: Model weights live in config, not code, so the model can be tuned and audited without a rewrite (see BUILD_PLAN.md, research registry).

demand_trend_shift.note: A declining local demand trend pushes the timeline one band sooner; growing pulls it one band later. Affects timeline only, never the base exposure score.

union_protection.note: Collective-bargaining coverage slows involuntary displacement (labour-economics research). Shifts the timeline one band later; never changes the base exposure score.

seniority.note: Experience shifts a worker's task mix toward less-exposed judgment and oversight work. Linear up to the cap.

confidence.note: Half-width of the reported exposure range, in points. Set wide on purpose: the backtest (CALIBRATION.md) shows the model ranks risk correctly in aggregate but predicts individual outcomes weakly (cross-validated R2 ~ 0.05), so honest results are ranges, not points.
